reviews.text: Rs. 499 ke earbuds itne achhe kaise ho sakte hain? I'm not kidding — these sound better than Rs. 5000 wale earbuds I had from a Korean brand. Bass is insane. Battery genuinely lasts 3-4 days. Ab toh backup bhi kharid liya.

reviews.name: Meera K.
reviews.text: The ANC on these is jaw-dropping for the price. I use them daily in my coworking space and can actually focus. The 45-hour battery means I charge them once a week. Once. A. Week. Mind = blown.

reviews.name: Gaming Guru

items.question: Are Rs. 499 earbuds actually good?
items.answer: Yes. We sell 100 million+ products because we build premium audio at honest prices. No middlemen, no retail markup. We manufacture our own drivers and chips, which lets us offer specs that competitors charge 3-5x more for.

items.question: How is the battery 40 hours?
items.answer: Efficient Bluetooth 5.3 chipset + our custom low-power audio codec + a high-density battery in each earbud = 10 hours per charge + 30 hours from the case. Real-world usage with average volume typically exceeds the rated spec.

items.question: Is the warranty good?
items.answer: 1-year hassle-free warranty on all products. Manufacturing defects are replaced (not repaired). Our service network covers 900+ cities. Most claims resolved within 48 hours.

items.question: What about return policy?
items.answer: 7-day no-questions-asked replacement on all orders. If you're not happy, send it back — we'll replace it or refund you. Free return shipping on all defective products.
